entities.name: NAS message
entities.description: This IE includes a complete plain NAS message as specified in clause 8.2 and 8.3.

entities.name: SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE
entities.description: A NAS message that is security protected and not considered a plain NAS message.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: A NAS message used for service requests that is not considered a plain NAS message.

entities.name: Plain NAS message condition
entities.description: Condition specifying that only plain NAS messages as defined in clauses 8.2 and 8.3 can be included in the NAS message IE.

relations.description: The NAS message IE is constrained to only include plain NAS messages as specified in clauses 8.2 and 8.3.
The plain NAS message condition establishes that SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE shall not be included in the NAS message IE.
The plain NAS message condition establishes that SERVICE REQUEST message shall not be included in the NAS message IE.
